_comment: CourtListener v4 citation-lookup endpoint. POSTs {"text": "<query>"} and takes element[0] of the returned array. Rate limits are bootstrapped from the CL docs URL at startup; the fallback numbers below are only used if that fetch fails. Citation-lookup publishes 60/min; hour/day are set equal to per_minute as a conservative fallback since CL doesn't publish separate hour/day caps for this endpoint.
